summary: Flagstar Bank, National Association provides banking products and services in the United States. The company's deposit products include interest-bearing checking and money market, savings, and non-interest-bearing accounts, as well as certificates of deposit. It offers loan products comprising multi-family loans; commercial real estate loans; acquisition, development, and construction loans; commercial and industrial loans; one-to-four family loans; specialty finance loans and leases; warehouse loans; and home equity lines of credit, as well as other consumer loans, including overdraft loans. The company offers non-deposit investment and insurance products; and online and mobile banking services. It primarily serves individuals, small and mid-size businesses, and professional associations. The company was formerly known as Flagstar Financial, Inc. Flagstar Bank, National Association was founded in 1859 and is headquartered in Hicksville, New York.
